tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: Lists every device screens.guide measured: iPhones, iPads and Android phones, tablets and foldables. Each row gives the id the other tools take, the unit (pt or dp), each screen with its portrait window size, the runtime builds read, and the current one. Filter by platform or kind.

tools.name: get_device
tools.description: Returns a device's measured readings: window, pixels, safe-area insets, corner radii, size classes, the status bar, the app's top bar (navigationBar: UINavigationBar, or Material 3's TopAppBar), the bottom tab bar (tabBar: UITabBar, or Material 3's NavigationBar), content margin, reserved regions an

tools.name: compare_devices
tools.description: Compares 2 to 8 different devices side by side, one row per device and screen: window size, pixels, pixels per unit, safe-area insets, the safe area's rectangle and corner radii. tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Converts lengths on one device between its layout unit (pt on iOS, dp on Android) and physical pixels (px), at the device's measured scale or density. For dp to px on Android it also gives the whole pixel Compose's Dp.roundToPx() returns. Each value is between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000.
